name: volibear-postban-race1-g2
description: Volibear after the bans of 23 Nov 2026, round 2 of the card-level search (lab/deckopt.py): from round 1's confirmed lists and round 1b's leaders, against the field without the banned cards (Kai'Sa 51, Kennen 44, the two post-ban Riven frames 20 each, Master Yi 16, Rek'Sai 10, Akali 8, Mordekaiser 8; lists patched by lab/tools/postban.py), with the pilot trained on list variations (spec_volibear_132_v0). Exploration and races with the cheap pilot, confirmation with the full one. Also the pool of the variations the Volibear training plays (loop.SPECIALISTS['volibear']['vary']). Stage race1: 14 lists on the same seeds, 2400 games per list shared out by the opponents' weights. This request: Kennen (zombro, post-ban) 596 games, Riven Shattered (post-ban frame) 272 games, Master Yi (PCQ, post-ban) 216 games, Akali (Vincent Nguyen, post-ban) 108 games.
